summary: Strong unit test coverage across all core functions (status classification, config import, report generation, output formatting) with deterministic test data and organized Describe/Context structure. Workflow tests validate structure and end-to-end acceptance via act. However, some edge cases are untested (timezone-related date behavior, very large policy day values, environment variable fallbacks claimed in code but not verified in tests). ActHarness module dependency and brittle act output string-matching reduce confidence in regression detection for integration layer. Missing fixture files in provided code make full assessment difficult. Core logic is well-protected; CI integration tests are somewhat fragile.
